items.title: Quarry Bank Scarecrow Festival
items.cost: Free event with normal admission; optional scarecrow trail £2.50
items.description: Quarry Bank's autumn festival runs daily from 10:30am to 5pm with a scarecrow trail, storytelling, crafts, games and indoor and outdoor family activities. Event activities are free with normal property admission; the outdoor scarecrow trail costs £2.50 extra.
items.reason: National Trust primary event page verifies 3 Oct–1 Nov, 10:30–17:00, booking not needed, free event with normal admission, and £2.50 optional trail.

items.title: Arc Saturday Art Club
items.venue: Arc at Hat Works, Wellington Road South, Stockport SK3 0EU
items.description: A family drop-in art club at Arc at Hat Works from 11am to 3pm, with activities designed for adults and children aged 3+. No booking is needed; a £3 charitable donation per artist is suggested for those who can afford it.
items.reason: Arc primary page verifies last-Saturday schedule, 11:00–15:00 drop-in format, ages 3+ and £3 suggested donation; Stockport Council event listing cross-checks the 31 Oct 2026 date and address.

items.title: Sisters Youth Qiyam – Y7–Y9
items.venue: Cheadle Masjid, 377 Wilmslow Road, Heald Green, Cheadle SK8 3NP
items.description: A Friday-night youth session for girls in school Years 7–9 with activities, games, reminders and refreshments. Registration is compulsory and opens at 8:30pm on the Wednesday before the event.
items.reason: Cheadle Masjid primary event page verifies 6 Nov, 20:30–23:00, venue and compulsory registration; the organiser's youth calendar lists the event as free.

items.title: North Room live at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club
items.venue: Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, Mellor Road, Cheadle Hulme SK8 5AT
items.description: Local band North Room play a Saturday-night set at Cheadle Hulme Conservative Club, with the venue describing a wide range of music and free entry.
items.reason: Venue's current primary events diary verifies Saturday 7 Nov, 20:45, North Room and free entry.

items.title: Journey to the Dark Side of the UNE
items.venue: Jodrell Bank, Bomish Lane, Lower Withington, Macclesfield SK11 9DW
items.description: UNE, the electronic dream-pop and ambient duo of Mark Radcliffe and Paul Langley, perform inside Jodrell Bank's Space Dome with full-dome visuals and a space conversation with Professor Tim O'Brien. Doors open at 7pm and the event runs 7:30pm to 10pm.
items.reason: Jodrell Bank primary event page verifies 12 Nov, £27, 19:30–22:00 with doors at 19:00, Space Dome format and booking route; retained as a distinctive worth-the-trip late-window listing.
